biography.plain_text: Rodin Younessi is an American entrepreneur and racing driver based in Florida. He built a group of motorcycle dealerships through acquisitions, after running a software company in Arizona. Trained as a lawyer, he treated legal knowledge as a business tool. His commercial interests included Harley-Davidson franchises and a Lamborghini dealership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Rodin Younessi concentrated his vehicle businesses around Harley-Davidson after buying Space Coast Harley-Davidson in 2010. He sold other companies to support that expansion, increased the stock of motorcycles and recruited mechanics. He worked on site and kept watch over the business.

He also assembled a racing operation that supported drivers besides himself. For the 2012 Indy Lights season, Younessi Racing signed Peter Dempsey and hired engineer Dave McMillan, reuniting a driver-engineer partnership from the previous year. Dempsey was assigned the team's car for the Freedom 100, with a two-car entry planned for Detroit so Younessi could also compete.
